messages:
tara-sec: FYI spinning up this thread - seeing sporadic SCIM 500s after last night's KMS rotate. ext_id missing for a handful of svcaccts and RBAC lookups fail. anyone on infra/idp?

jing-idp: I saw a few alerts. Which key alias did we switch to?

tara-sec: alias/redwood-p-2026-03-23. Logs show mix of InvalidCiphertextException and success for same alias. snippet:
```
2026-03-23T03:12:44Z scim-provisioner ERROR svc=prov-3 kms:Decrypt failed alias/redwood-p-2026 InvalidCiphertextException
2026-03-23T03:12:44Z scim-provisioner INFO svc=prov-3 kms:Decrypt succeeded alias/redwood-p-2026 keyVersion=2
```

noah-sre: sounds like a rewrap visibility race. Some replicas may have cached envelopes wrapped by old key, others see new metadata. Any RBAC/IAM changes for the service role?

jing-idp: no IAM tweaks. Rewrap job kicked off from orchestration at 02:58UTC. Old alias alias/redwood-p still points to prior key.

tara-sec: failures concentrated on prov-3 and prov-9 in us-west-2. restarting prov-3 now to force metadata reload.

oncall-bot: restart prov-3 requested by tara-sec (in progress)

noah-sre: while you restart, add a temporary 429/retry for ext_id-not-found in provisioner to avoid downstream denies during maintenance.

jing-idp: good call. I'll prepare a dry-run backfill that scans envelope metadata and rewraps any leftover old-key envelopes to new keyVersion. will add a replication-check before marking rewrap complete.

tara-sec: prov-3 restart done, errors dropped. prov-9 had a few retries and recovered.

noah-sre: action items: 1) execute dry-run backfill and report counts; 2) add replication confirmation to rewrap job; 3) create alert for mixed-key decrypt patterns (InvalidCiphertext + Success for same alias).

tara-sec: assigning jing -> backfill dry-run; noah -> alert + short retry PR; oncall-bot -> update runbook steps for KMS rotate (replica restart + replication check).

jing-idp: ETA for dry-run 4h. will post results here.

tara-sec: TL;DR probable cause = non-atomic rewrap/metadata propagation leading to cached DEKs mismatching envelope metadata. short-term: restart replicas and soft-retry ext_id misses. medium-term: replication guard + backfill. thanks :wave:
